comment: Dr. Leo is AMAZING! He is one of my favorite professors so far! He cares a lot about his students, and it was clear that he wanted us to succeed. The nights before exams, he would stay until after midnight to make sure we understood it. Chemistry is hard, but Dr. Leo made it as easy as it could be by teaching in a way we understood. 10/10 recommend

This class is less difficult than other chem major classes, but still requires some significant studying. The only homework was watching lectures and making notesheets that could be used on tests, which definitely made them less scary.

Dr. Leo has been one of my favorite teachers at UR for my time here. He organizes the class to convey the information in a logical manner. Each concept builds upon the previous as a fast pace, which for a difficult course is needed. He caters the lecture to what will be needed for the test. I would highly reccomend!

If mentors were Pokémon, you'd be rare,
Legendary, unmatched—beyond compare.
Best professor? That's undersold—
You're Nobel Prize–worthy, made of gold.

The absolute GOAT, if you have the opportunity to take Dr. Leo anytime during college do it. Leo cares so much about his teaching and I don't think I will ever find a better professor .You are doing yourself a disservice if you do not take his class.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! His class and tests are HARD but not unreasonable. Make sure to stay on top of your work, and do a lot of practice problems. Dr. Leo knows what he is talking about, and cares about every single one of his students. He would stay in Gotty until 2am the night before a test to help you. 100% would recommend.
GOAT

Drop everything & take his class/lab rn. I had him for CHEM/ENVR 110 labs. Hilarious, enthusiastic, upbeat, authentic, & super clear. Weekly thursday lab, report & pre-labs due weekly (be on time), labs very straightforward & he gives good explanations beforehand. Very refreshing amid other professors who are convoluted or monotone.

Dr. Leo was great for CHEM 141. I took AP chem in high school and I was totally prepared for this class. It was easy for me because it was an "introductory chemistry" class but lots of my friends struggled and Dr. Leo was always more than willing to help and stay late. He often stayed until 2 am the night before a test to help his students study!!!
I cried because of how much I love Dr. Leo, one of the most inspirational professor I have EVER had.

I love Dr. Leo! I felt that he was not only concerned with how I understood chemistry and the material but also with my well-being. He had many study sessions the night before tests, some even going until 3:00 am. He is an amazing teacher and mentor. I wouldn't understand or love chemistry as much as I do if it weren't for him. Take his class!!
Fantastic professor

Dr. Leo is by far the best professor at Richmond. You can not go wrong taking his class. He will stay after class the day before a test until 1 am if needed, he just cares about his students that much. Be prepared for difficult tests though, but Dr. Leo looks for points to give you. Dr. Leo gears you for success. Take him if you can.

Leo is incredible. Hilarious lectures, yet still gets to all of the material and does a really good job explaining tough concepts. Incredibly dedicated to his students and willing to work with them. A+ guy.

Dr Leo is the best Chem teacher I've ever had. You learn a lot but he keeps every lecture interesting so you never get bored.  He goes at a good pace for his lectures. He is always available to meet outside of class if you don't get something. He wants you to succeed in his class. He's very understanding but wants you to prioritize the class also.

Dr. Leo was an amazing professor. He cares about his students and wants them to succeed and he shows that in his teaching. His class is fast paced but he does his best to fit in all the material with extra time for questions and review. His exams are meant to challenge you, but putting in the time and effort gets you far. He's also easy to reach.

Dr. Leo is an amazing teacher. He is always willing to help, holds review sessions, and his lectures are engaging. His tests are designed to challenge you, but he will give you all the materials you need to succeed in this class.

Great professor. I 100% recommend him. Lectures can sometimes be a bit complex, but he provides support and makes the lectures fun. He's a funny guy and wants everyone to succeed. Test averages were usually 85-90% so take that as you wish. He stays in the office as late as you wish the night before tests to review. Homework is not difficult
This is a hard class that requires a lot of work. There's no getting around that. Dr. Leopold designed the class in a way to make it bearable, which I appreciate.
One of the best Chemistry profs. He is very relatable, and funny too. His tests are straightforward. Just take him.

Dr. Leo's class was fantastic! His asynchronous lectures were concise and very clearly explained the topics. Synchronous lectures were optional but highly recommended. His tests are challenging but certainly manageable. I would highly recommend Dr. Leo for CHEM141!

Professor Leopold put his utmost effort into making sure that each student learned what they needed to in order to be prepared for our upcoming chemistry courses (since most of us are pre-health students). He always offers help outside of class and wants everyone (who works hard) to succeed. Go to study sessions outside of class!

Best professor I've ever had. Dr. Leo was always available for help outside of class and worked hard to make sure his students understood the material. He loves his job and is invested in his students success. He made the transition online easy. He continued to lecture, provided videos and was still meeting with students virtually. take his classes

Leo is the best teacher I have had at at UR. He works incredibly hard to make sure students understand him and is very receptive to criticism or feedback. While his course is not easy, he makes the students feel heard and that they are being given a fair chance to do well.

Dr. Leo is all you can ask for from a professor and more. He genuinely cares about the success of each and every student and will do anything necessary to help you understand a problem/concept if you ask him. If that's not enough, it's possible to test out of his final and he's stayed on campus 'til after 2AM helping students the day before an exam

Dr. Leo is one of the best teachers I've ever had. He is always more than willing to help. The night before a test he will stay at his office until everyone has left to make sure everyone's questions are answered..I can't say the same for most teachers. If you work hard he won't let you get a bad grade. Great guy, take his class, you wont regret it

Dr.Leo is one of the best science proffs ever! He is hilarious and a wonderful teacher. Dr.Leo is so passionate about his job and cares so much about his students. The night before an exam he will stay until 2am to answer questions. He looks very highly on effort. With his stories and anecdotes, its hard to not pay attention.  TAKE DR.LEO'S CLASS:)

Dr. Leo is by far the best teacher at UR. He is down to earth, super-smart, and really cares about his students. He is also my academic adviser, and he's very helpful in that respect. You can go to him with any questions, and he nearly lives in Gottwald. His pre-lab lectures are very thorough, and he connects well with students. Tough grader...

Best professor I've had at Richmond so far.  He will take time to make sure you understand a concept.  I recommed the weekly study sessions, even if you understand the information.  His tests are challenging, not hard.  He tests you to make sure you fully understand something and didn't cram or memorize.  This class is beneficial for science majors

Dr. Leo is a really cool guy.  I would recommend him.  His tests are hard, but fair.  If you study hard, you can do well.  He has a dorky, but funny sense of humor.  Good guy to joke with, class is entertaining.
dr. leo rox my sox... and i mean the red sox

I had Dr. Leo for lab.  He was one of the best teachers I ever had at the University.  A great guy and baseball fan, he is also very funny and always starts lab with a joke.  He is also more than willing to help you outside class.  If you can I would highly advise his course.

By far the best teacher I have had at the University of Richmond. Very understanding when it comes to the difficulty of Analytical Chemistry. Practically failed the first 2 tests and I still ended getting a B+ in the class; does more than any other teacher when it comes to out of class help.
One of the best teachers I have ever had.  Not easy, but vary fair, and is extremely helpful.   He cares a lot about his students, and it shows.  If you have the change to take him you should.

I LOVED this class! It def was not easy but Dr. Leo always did everything he could to make sure his class was fair and that his students understood the material. I wouldn't recommend anyone else for this class, he's really worth taking

chem 141:  dr. leo is the best teacher i have had at richmond. he is not very easy but it is totally worth it because he is such a good and helpful teacher. he really wants his students to succeed and will do anything to be fair and help them. i HIGHLY recommend taking him you wont regret it

One of the better teachers of the chemistry department. Not the best lecturer, Myers has that distinction, but Analysis isn't that complex a topic, just lots of material so he did a good job of it. Stays all hours of the week and very helpful with questions. Willing to hold long study sessions before exams. Favors students who give a lot of effort.
Funny guy.  Great teacher.  Tests are a little hard, but its all fair in the end.
Best prof in the chem department! He's not easy and makes you learn the material but he is fair, EXTREMELY helpful and dedicated, and absolutely hilarious. Definitely take his class!

so awesome! i'm a huge leo fan after taking his lab for chem. i looked forward to his weekly lab! very available, funny, helpful, awesome! hard work is rewarded with dr leo. i'm planning on doing research with him next year!

Dr. Leo runs a difficult class but if you do the reading and homework and go to review sessions you'll be fine.  He is very helpful and stays in his office all night before a test to help students.  He likes to see his students trying and sometimes gives extra points for effort.  He's not an easy teacher but he's extremely fair, funny, and helpful.
i strongly disagree with the other positive ratings for dr. leo. he was never helpful and favors certain students. one of the worst profs in the chem department.

I wouldn't take this class to get rid of your science requirement, but if your pre med, this should be your class. He is an amazing guy, funny, and really really smart. If you do the work, pay attention, and take good notes, you will be fine. There is no way another can hate. Dr. Leo!!
Amazing prof! His tests are challanging, but will stay until 2AM the night before a test-he will do anything to help you learn. Definitely take him.

great prof, definately take him
Dr. Leo is a great teacher and very helpful when you have questions or problems comprehending the always difficult material. His tests are always hard and he makes you think
